In [[4 ABY]],<ref name="Date" /> after the [[Battle of Endor]], the [[New Republic]] were involved in '''fighting''' at<ref name="Alphabet Squadron" /> the [[Expansion Region]] astronomical object<ref name="TFABG">[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens Beginner Game|''Star Wars: The Force Awakens'' Beginner Game]]</ref> [[Yinchorr]]. While at her desk aboard her [[flagship]]—the [[Acclamator-class transgalactic military assault ship|''Acclamator''-class battleship]] ''[[Lodestar]]''—[[General]] [[Hera Syndulla]] was delivered an intelligence brief by her<ref name="Alphabet Squadron" /> [[aide]]<ref name="Shadow Fall">''[[Shadow Fall: An Alphabet Squadron Novel]]''</ref> [[Stornvein]] which mentioned the fighting at Yinchorr had developed into a siege situation. Syndulla read the brief and mentally noted about its contents.<ref name="Alphabet Squadron" />

==Behind the scenes==
The siege at Yinchorr was mentioned in the [[2019]] novel [[Alphabet Squadron (novel)|''Alphabet Squadron'']] written by [[Alexander Freed]] as the first installment in the ''[[Star Wars: Alphabet Squadron]]'' trilogy.<ref name="Alphabet Squadron" />
